title: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES GRADE 2
text:
HOLIDAY ASSIGNMENT
 GRADE 2 ENGLISH
COMPLETE GRADE TWO HOME ASSIGNMENT
 ENGLISH ACTIVITIES GRADE 2
 Spell the words correctly.
 1. useho
 2. gdo
 3. bleta
 4. tac
 5. toag
 Fill in the blanks using the word ‘was’.
 6. The boy washing his clothes.
 7. The dog barking loudly.
 8. She singing softly.
 9. The girl dancing.
 Write three sentences using the word (were)
 10.
 11.
 12.
 Use ‘have’ or ‘has’
 13.My friend two eyes.
 14.Our teacher one head.
 15.We many fingers.
 16.I a storybook.
 17.They many sweets.
 Write the missing months.
 18.January March
 19.April May July
 20. October November
 Make correct sentences.
 21.We sing to songs like.
 22.My is birthday May in.
 Fill in the blanks.
 Example: The teacher put the books on the shelf. (shelves)
 23.Mother has three (knife)
 24.My brother has two (loaf)
 25.Asha was picking (leaf)
